items.title: AI Risk Is 'Moving Somewhere Harder to See': Citigroup, JPMorgan Reportedly Look to Offload AI Debt as Investors Grow Wary of Buildout
items.summary: Banks have reportedly put portfolios of artificial intelligence-related loans on the market to shed risk or free up capacity to lend more, as investor appetite for the debt behind the buildout tests. Banks Shop Their AI Loans Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) and JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) are among the banks trying to “offload some of their exposure to AI-related debt,” according to a Semafor report, citing people familiar with the deals.
